Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Camera on the front-wall side of the landing, at the stone-corridor end, facing the autumn landscape painting on the back wall; the axis runs from the painting's elevator side to the walnut front door. Ji Ran stands beneath the autumn landscape painting, on its elevator side, in her black satin slip dress, facing the walnut front door. Lin Qingyu stands close beside her, nearer the console table, in his white T-shirt and open black bomber jacket. His right arm is around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens hangs from his left hand. Lu Shaoze stands on the front-door side of the landing, a few paces in front of the tall walnut front door with the black smart lock, in his navy double-breasted suit over a black silk shirt, facing them. The brushed-steel elevator doors on the left wall are closed. There is one slim dark-wood console table under the painting, between two brass wall sconces.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the stone-corridor end facing the painting on the back wall. Beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran by the waist with the grocery bag of greens in his other hand. Lu Shaoze, on the front-door side, glares across the stone floor at his arm.
Panel 2: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door. Lu Shaoze, in front of the walnut front door, jabs a finger at Lin Qingyu's arm around Ji Ran's waist, his face hard.
Panel 3: Medium shot, two-shot composition, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the painting and the elevator doors. Under the painting, Lin Qingyu smiles brightly, slides his right arm off Ji Ran's waist and holds his right hand out toward the front door, the grocery bag still in his left hand. Ji Ran stays beside him.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, eye level, from the front-wall side. Lin Qingyu keeps his hand extended toward Lu Shaoze's place by the front door, with a sunny, innocent grin.
Panel 5: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot, locked-off camera, eye level, over Lin Qingyu's shoulder toward the walnut front door. Over Lin Qingyu's shoulder, Lu Shaoze stares down at the offered hand and folds his arms without taking it.
Panel 6: Medium shot, two-shot composition, handheld camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting. Lin Qingyu lowers his unshaken hand, turns his head to Ji Ran beside him under the painting and nudges her playfully. Ji Ran keeps her cool face toward the front door.
Panel 7: Medium shot, low angle, locked-off camera, from the front-wall side angled toward the walnut front door. Lu Shaoze unfolds his arms and steps one pace forward from the front door. He points at Lin Qingyu while looking at Ji Ran.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, dirty single, locked-off camera, eye level, from the front-wall side facing the painting. Ji Ran folds her arms beneath the painting and answers with a flat, bored look, a sliver of Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge.
Panel 9: Close-up, quick push in on Lu Shaoze's face, eye level, from the front-wall side angled toward the front door. Lu Shaoze's jaw clenches and his eyes widen in disbelief. His hands tighten into fists.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
